method: Source-informed implementation estimate, not pixel similarity, runtime coverage, effort remaining or physical-phone verification. Visual layout 40%, styling 30%, controls 20%, states/safety 10%. Each dimension uses 0 absent, 1 minimal, 2 partial, 3 mostly present, 4 complete for supported scope. Board score is mean of unrounded panel scores rounded to nearest 5; panel tags also rounded to nearest 5. Scores are provisional; allow roughly ±15 points where runtime evidence is absent and ±10 where partial captures exist. Unsupported generated features are documented adaptations, not automatic requirements.
